content: .nojekyll: file at site root makes Pages skip Jekyll build; without it, paths starting with underscore are ignored (Jekyll treats them as partials). This repo has no underscore paths planned, but committing .nojekyll keeps deploys deterministic and skips Jekyll processing entirely. Note upload-pages-artifact excludes dotfiles unless include-hidden-files: true. Community knowledge; GitHub docs page was reorganized so primary URL no longer resolves.
